head: feature/custom-fields-templates
title: feat: customizable logbook with dynamic field types, templates, and entity linking
body:
## Summary

Implements a fully customizable logbook system with 15 canonical field types, schema templates (built-in/personal/global), entity linking, and private attachments.

## Changes

### Database (4 migrations)
- 015: Field rules, schema_revision, provenance
- 016: schema_templates table with scope/version/fork tracking
- 017: field_attachments table with lease-based upload lifecycle
- 018: Entity linking support

### Backend
- domain/fieldSchema.js: Canonical type validation with RE2JS regex
- functions/templates.js: Template CRUD + 4 built-in presets
- functions/attachments.js: Lease creation, finalization, cleanup
- routes/templates.js, routes/attachments.js: REST endpoints

### Frontend
- lib/fieldSchema.ts, lib/fieldValidation.ts: Type definitions
- lib/templateApi.ts, lib/attachmentApi.ts: API clients
- components/fields/FieldEditors.tsx: Typed editors for all 15 types
- components/fields/FieldDisplay.tsx: Read-only display
- components/fields/TemplatePicker.tsx: Template selection UI

### Documentation
- Issue 52: Comprehensive documentation

## Field Types

text, markdown, integer, float, date, timestamp, boolean, select, multiselect, geolocation, currency, file, image, entity_link

## Template Scopes

- Built-in: 4 system presets
- Personal: User-created templates
- Global: Admin-created shared templates

Templates are deep-copied into projects on creation (no live inheritance).

Closes #52
